detail.query:
UNLOAD (
select
	  nid_renta										as nro_renta
	, nid_endoso									as nro_endoso
	, ramo_point_t									as ramo
	, fec_expedicion_renta
	, per_expedicion_renta
	, cod_tipo_renta								as cod_tipo_movimiento
	, dsc_tipo_renta								as dsc_tipo_movimiento
	, (case
            when cod_tipo_renta <> 3 then 'Reintegro de Renta'
            else 'Renta Vejez'
        end)										as dsc_tipo_movimiento_h
	, cod_dvlcn_rntgr								as cod_tipo_renta
	, dsc_dvlcn_rntgr								as dsc_tipo_renta
	, cast(sum(vlr_endoso) as decimal(38, 0))		as vlr_prima
	, 'Endoso'										as naturaleza
	, per_expedicion_endoso							as periodo
from "niif-{env}-gold-catalog-db"."scd_primas_endosos"
where per_expedicion_endoso = '$period'
and act_reg = 1
group by nid_renta
	, nid_endoso
	, ramo_point_t
	, cod_tipo_renta
	, dsc_tipo_renta
	, (case
            when cod_tipo_renta <> 3 then 'Reintegro de Renta'
            else 'Renta Vejez'
        end)
	, fec_expedicion_renta
	, per_expedicion_renta
	, cod_dvlcn_rntgr
	, dsc_dvlcn_rntgr
	, 'Endoso'
	, per_expedicion_endoso
union
select
	  nid_renta										as nro_renta
	, nid_renta										as nro_endoso
	, '052'											as ramo
	, fec_expedicion_renta
	, per_expedicion_renta
	, cod_tipo_renta								as cod_tipo_movimiento
	, dsc_tipo_renta								as dsc_tipo_movimiento
	, 'Renta Invalidez Muerte'						as dsc_tipo_movimiento_h
	, 3												as cod_tipo_renta
	, 'Renta Nueva'									as dsc_tipo_renta
	, cast(sum(vlr_renta) as decimal(38, 0))		as vlr_prima
	, 'Renta'										as naturaleza
	, per_pago_renta								as periodo
from "niif-{env}-gold-catalog-db"."scd_primas_rentas"
where per_pago_renta = '$period'
and act_reg = 1
group by nid_renta
	, nid_renta
	, '052'
	, fec_expedicion_renta
	, per_expedicion_renta
	, cod_tipo_renta
	, dsc_tipo_renta
	, 'Renta Invalidez Muerte'
	, 3
	, 'Renta Nueva'
	, 'Renta'
	, per_pago_renta
)
TO 's3://$assets_bucket/athena/notifications/unload/$execution_id/'
WITH (
    format = 'TEXTFILE',
    field_delimiter = '|',
    compression = 'NONE'
);

	, dsc_dvlcn_rntgr								as dsc_tipo_renta
	, cast(sum(vlr_endoso) as decimal(38, 7))		as vlr_prima
	, 'Endoso'										as naturaleza

from "niif-{env}-gold-catalog-db"."scd_primas_endosos"
where per_expedicion_endoso = '$period'
and act_reg = 1
group by nid_renta
	, nid_endoso
	, ramo_point_t
	, cod_tipo_renta
	, dsc_tipo_renta
	, (case
            when cod_tipo_renta <> 3 then 'Reintegro de Renta'
            else 'Renta Vejez'
        end)
	, fec_expedicion_renta
	, per_expedicion_renta
	, cod_dvlcn_rntgr
	, dsc_dvlcn_rntgr
	, 'Endoso'
	, per_expedicion_endoso)
union
(select
	  nid_renta										as nro_renta
	, nid_renta										as nro_endoso
	, '052'											as ramo
	, fec_expedicion_renta
	, per_expedicion_renta
	, cod_tipo_renta								as cod_tipo_movimiento
	, dsc_tipo_renta								as dsc_tipo_movimiento
	, 'Renta Invalidez Muerte'						as dsc_tipo_movimiento_h
	, 3												as cod_tipo_renta
	, 'Renta Nueva'									as dsc_tipo_renta
	, cast(sum(vlr_renta) as decimal(38, 7))		as vlr_prima
	, 'Renta'										as naturaleza
	, per_pago_renta								as periodo
from "niif-{env}-gold-catalog-db"."scd_primas_rentas"
where per_pago_renta = '$period'
and act_reg = 1
group by nid_renta
	, nid_renta
	, '052'
	, fec_expedicion_renta
	, per_expedicion_renta
	, cod_tipo_renta
	, dsc_tipo_renta
	, 'Renta Invalidez Muerte'
	, 3
	, 'Renta Nueva'
	, 'Renta'
	, per_pago_renta))
group by periodo
	, dsc_tipo_renta
	, ramo
order by dsc_tipo_renta desc
	, ramo
